title: Deliver a reply that won't fit in one platform message
trigger_text: delivering a response or plan to the user whose content is too long for one message on the current platform
preconditions: the content to send exceeds what fits in a single platform message

body.instruction: Decide the shape of the content: prose (an explanation, a narrative answer) vs. structured (a plan, a checklist, code, a table)
For prose, split at natural boundaries — paragraphs or sections — and send each piece with its own deliver_reply call. Never cut mid-sentence or mid-word.
For structured content that would lose its shape split across messages (a plan, a checklist, code), send it whole via deliver_attachment with a short, descriptive filename instead of splitting it.

If a deliver_reply or deliver_attachment call fails with content_too_long, that piece is still too big — split it further (prose) or switch to deliver_attachment (structured), don't retry the same call unchanged.

done_criteria: all of the content has actually reached the user, across however many messages or an attachment it took
notes: Prefer the fewest messages that stay readable — don't split more finely than the natural boundaries call for.
A failed delivery call is a signal to change strategy, not to retry identically.
